private LayoutInfo computeLayoutInfo(String name, Set<String> visiting) {
  if (!visiting.add(name)) return EMPTY;
  LayoutInfo cached = mCache.get(name);
  if (cached != null) { visiting.remove(name); return cached; }
  List<FileData> files = mLayouts.get(name);
  if (files == null) { visiting.remove(name); return EMPTY; }
  
  Set<String> ids = new HashSet<>();
  Set<String> rootIds = new HashSet<>();
  Set<String> dups = new HashSet<>();
  
  for (FileData file : files) {
    Set<String> fileIds = new HashSet<>();
    Set<String> fileDups = new HashSet<>();
    
    // root include
    if (file.rootInclude != null) {
      LayoutInfo child = computeLayoutInfo(file.rootInclude.layoutName, visiting);
      Set<String> childIds = applyOverride(child, file.rootInclude.overrideId);
      Set<String> childDups = applyOverrideToDups(child, file.rootInclude.overrideId);
      for (String id : childIds) {
        if (!fileIds.add(id)) fileDups.add(id);
      }
      fileDups.addAll(childDups);
      // root ids of this file = child's root ids after override
      Set<String> childRootIds = applyOverrideToRootIds(child, file.rootInclude.overrideId);
      rootIds.addAll(childRootIds);
    } else {
      for (IdOccurrence occ : file.ids) {
        if (occ.isRoot) rootIds.add(occ.id); // we can store rootIds directly
        if (!fileIds.add(occ.id)) fileDups.add(occ.id);

      LayoutInfo child = computeLayoutInfo(inc.layoutName, visiting);
      Set<String> childIds = applyOverride(child, inc.overrideId);
      Set<String> childDups = applyOverrideToDups(child, inc.overrideId);
